Editor.NameTooltip:
Start or end the name with ::x where x is a number to use icons, i.e. "::2914".
Use ## anywhere in the name to make the text afterwards into a tooltip,
i.e. "Name##This is a Tooltip".
Editor.NameTooltipIcons:
Icons accept arguments between "::" and their ID. I.e. "::f21".
	' f ' - Applies the hotbar frame.
	' n ' - Removes the hotbar frame.
	' l ' - Uses the low resolution icon.
	' h ' - Uses the high resolution icon if it exists.
	' g ' - Changes the icon to grayscale.
	' r ' - Reverses the icon.
Editor.CommandTooltip:
You can use right click to add special game symbols, additionally,
there are custom commands that only work from shortcuts.
	' //m0 ' - Executes individual macro #0 (up to //m99).
	' //m100 ' - Executes shared macro #0 (up to //m199).
	' //m ' - Begins or ends a custom macro. The following lines
will execute as a macro instead of a shortcut (allowing for
/wait, /macrolock, etc), until //m is used again, up to 30 lines.
	' //i <ID/Name> ' - Uses an item, cannot be used with //m.
	' // <Comment> ' - Adds a comment.

Timespan.Tooltip:
Timespan should be formatted as "XX:XX-XX:XX" (24h) and may contain "X" wildcards.
I.e "XX:30-XX:10" will return true for times such as 01:30, 13:54, and 21:09.
The minimum time is inclusive, but the maximum is not.

UpdateWindow.Title: QoLBarEx Updated!
UpdateWindow.Body: QoLBarEx has a new feature where categories may now run commands like a normal shortcut, this may cause problems for people who were using the plugin BEFORE JANUARY 4TH, due to the command setting being used for tooltips. Please verify that you understand the risks and that YOU MAY ACCIDENTALLY SEND CHAT MESSAGES WHEN CLICKING CATEGORIES. Additionally, YOU MAY DELETE ALL COMMANDS FROM ALL CATEGORIES AFTERWARDS if you are worried. Selecting YES will remove EVERY command from EVERY category in your config, note that this has no real downside if you have not started to utilize this feature. Selecting NO will close this popup permanently, you may also change your mind after selecting YES if you restore the version backup from the config, please be aware that old configs will possibly contain commands again if you do reload one of them.
